w:r.w:t: Website & Client Portal — Full Platform Specification
Public Website + AMC Client Portal + Admin Panel

Horexa Solutions is a professional hospitality hygiene and maintenance service company specializing in kitchen exhaust duct cleaning, ventilation hygiene, fire-risk reduction, and Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) services for hotels, restaurants, cloud kitchens, hospitals, and commercial food-service establishments across India.
This document defines the full product requirements for the Horexa Solutions digital platform, comprising:
A public-facing marketing website to showcase services, generate inspection leads, and build brand credibility
An AMC Client Portal allowing clients to log in, view inspection reports, track compliance, and manage their contracts
An Admin Panel for the Horexa internal team to manage inquiries, projects, content, AMC plans, careers, and website settings

The platform is designed around a premium dark corporate industrial visual identity, using a black/dark-charcoal base with orange (#E8650A) accents, projecting professionalism, safety, and authority in the commercial kitchen hygiene space.
Establish a credible professional online presence for Horexa Solutions
Generate qualified inspection request leads from hotel, restaurant, and cloud kitchen operators
Showcase before/after project portfolio to build conversion confidence
Promote and convert AMC (Annual Maintenance Contract) plans
Provide a self-service portal for existing AMC clients to access their compliance data
Support national expansion by listing service areas across major Indian cities

Rate limiting on login endpoints to prevent brute force
Passwords stored as salted hashes (bcrypt or Argon2)
All images compressed and served in WebP format with JPEG fallback
Lazy loading on all below-fold images and video
Critical CSS inlined; non-critical CSS deferred
JavaScript bundled and minified with code splitting for portal routes
Target: Google Lighthouse Performance score ≥ 90 on desktop, ≥ 80 on mobile
Core Web Vitals: LCP < 2.5s, FID < 100ms, CLS < 0.1
